title.en: Enter a workspace from the agent list
title.zh: 可从智能体列表直接进入工作区

description.en: A cleaner top bar with a more prominent Workspace / This Computer switch and workspace tabs you can drag to reorder; agent actions moved under the agent's name; a simpler device connection page; signing out now asks for confirmation.
description.zh: 顶部栏更简洁，「工作区 / 本机管理」切换更醒目，工作区标签可拖动排序；智能体操作按钮移至名称下方；设备连接页更简洁；退出登录前增加确认。
